overview_description.description:
Taito.ai is an AI-first people operations system for founders, operators, and people pioneers at growing companies.

People directory, time off, documents & eSignatures, people agents, and performance in one place. Set it up yourself in under 30 minutes. Configure your onboarding, probation, and offboarding once — Taito runs them on autopilot from there.

It works where your team already works: in Slack for day-to-day requests and approvals, and via MCP for any AI tool in your stack. Regional compliance is built in from day one. ISO 27001 certified and GDPR compliant.

Built for founders and early operators who need a scalable people ops foundation without adding admin headcount — and for people pioneers who were hired for strategy, not for building spreadsheets and chasing forms.

product.name: Employee Performance Enablement Platform
product.description: An AI-driven platform that automates continuous employee feedback, personal development plans, and performance insights integrated into existing workplace tools.

product.name: 1-1 Meeting Copilot
product.description: An AI tool that helps leaders prepare agendas, document decisions, and generate summaries for one-on-one meetings to improve meeting productivity and follow-up.

product.name: Continuous Feedback Automation
product.description: A system that automates the collection and analysis of ongoing, actionable employee feedback integrated into existing communication platforms.

product.name: AI-Assisted Personal Development Plans
product.description: An AI-powered tool that helps employees set, track, and manage personal development goals aligned with their roles and company objectives.

product.name: AI-Driven Performance Insights and Coaching
product.description: AI-powered analysis and coaching tools that provide real-time insights and recommendations to support employee development and leadership decision-making.
